product.name: RailKit
product.description: Production-ready railway data through a typed Node.js SDK or direct REST endpoints.

categories.label: Booking & fares
categories.description: Passenger records, seat inventory, and journey pricing.

categories.label: Train operations
categories.description: Schedules, live movement, completed journeys, and disruptions.

categories.label: Stations & discovery
categories.description: Find trains and inspect station activity.

endpoints.title: Check PNR status
endpoints.summary: Get journey, coach, berth, and current confirmation details for every passenger on a booking.
notes: Booking status and current status can differ after chart preparation.

endpoints.title: Check seat availability
endpoints.summary: Check inventory for one train, route, date, travel class, and quota.
endpoints.sdkSignature: getAvailability(trainNo, fromStnCode, toStnCode, date, coach, quota)
notes: Availability changes frequently; avoid long-lived caching.
Class and quota must be supported by selected train.

endpoints.title: Look up fare
endpoints.summary: Return base fare, reservation, superfast, catering, tax, dynamic fare, and final collectible amount.
endpoints.sdkSignature: fareLookup(trainNo, fromStnCode, toStnCode, date, travelClass, quota)

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Travel class such as 3A, SL, or CC.

parameters.name: quota
parameters.description: Booking quota such as GN or TQ.

notes: Returned fare represents selected class and quota.
Dynamic pricing may change between requests.

endpoints.title: Get train information
endpoints.summary: Retrieve identity, running days, route, schedule, and station-level details for a train.
notes: Train numbers remain strings to preserve leading zeros.

endpoints.title: Track live train
endpoints.summary: Track current movement with station-by-station timing, delay, platform, and position context.
notes: Live status depends on upstream railway updates.
SDK date is optional and defaults to today.

endpoints.title: Get train history
endpoints.summary: Read completed journey history with actual timings, per-stop delays, and final coach position.

parameters.name: journeyDate
parameters.description: Completed journey date in DD-MM-YYYY format.

notes: Returns 404 until journey reaches its destination.
Use live tracking for active journeys.

endpoints.title: List cancelled trains
endpoints.summary: List fully and partially cancelled services, including affected route segments.
notes: Partial cancellations include affected origin and destination stations.

endpoints.title: Find trains between stations
endpoints.summary: Find direct trains between two stations with timetable, classes, and running-day data.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional journey date in DD-MM-YYYY format.

notes: Omit date to return general timetable matches.

endpoints.title: Get live station board
endpoints.summary: Get upcoming and passing trains at a station with expected times, delays, and platform details.

parameters.name: hrs
parameters.description: Time window in hours; defaults to 2.

notes: Platform values can change close to arrival.
Use 2-hour windows for frequent polling and smaller payloads.
